Decorative stalls/cars/trees also lack data-based collision and need per-object classification before fixes.

nextLimitedTaskProposal.name: One readable onboarding block + coherent solid/door rendering
scope: A/service and first route only for tutorial; no new currencies or quest lines
Classify 3 infill houses and solid-looking props: actual ground footprints in shared data OR move scenery to nonwalkable background. Do not just put player above every object.
Derive rendered service exit from real target position; check other doors/stairs similarly
One consistent character silhouette across transitions; optional temporary occlusion silhouette where actual back paths remain valid, separate from collision repair
acceptance: First player can explain immediate goal within first minute without external hints
Walk -> approach -> interact -> confirm cycle is experienced on first visible block; skip/help and keyboard/touch remain usable
Normal-input path cannot enter any newly registered solid footprint; old safe points and all exits remain reachable
Each painted doorway/arrow is within the real target interaction area; the service exit works at its displayed marker
At building rear/edge/screen/door player remains identifiable; correct front/back relation still holds
Style is chosen from owner-approved concept alternatives before broad map painting
notClaimed: No full browser run in this audit
No new real-device or first-player validation
Not all owner-reported clipping reproduced; only named infill and exit cases proven
No final art or large-map scope accepted by this audit

eastwardLesson: Use composed small spaces, an immediate purpose, readable warm/cool focal lighting, recognizable silhouettes, dense but navigable props, and character-to-door scale. Do not import proprietary assets or infer pixel art approval from the reference.
